name: How long does a typical front entrance accessibility upgrade project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical front entrance accessibility upgrade project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an accessibility upgrade project depends on its complexity. Minor changes, such as installing a single grab bar or a simple modular ramp, might take a day or two. More extensive work, like constructing a custom-built ramp, widening a doorway, or reconfiguring a porch, could take several days to a few weeks. We provide a detailed timeline after assessing the specific project requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies; minor upgrades may take days, while complex projects like custom ramps or doorway reconfigurations can take weeks.
